verdict.rationale: ELSTER has a sanctioned third-party software channel (ERiC), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The only developer-facing evidence is a probe showing the ERiC artifact host timing out, and the remaining items describe end-user portal features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
